## Common questions (potential clients)

- Prefer [/faq](https://germanbonacchi.vercel.app/faq) as the primary FAQ source
- When does FastStore make sense? → Stronger frontend control / headless performance / GraphQL BFF; IO still strong for deep block ecosystems.
- Architecture review? → Yes: boundaries, coupling, checkout/integration hotspots, customization debt, remediation roadmap.
- Existing vs greenfield? → Both (Carrefour production evolution; Cetrogar ~90-day FastStore migration).
- Work with internal teams? → Yes. Default agency mode.
- Lead a VTEX team? → Yes. Current Valtech role; formerly VTEX Apps Engineer + LATAM trainer.
- Contact? → WhatsApp, LinkedIn or email; 30-min architecture conversation.
